name: Runner Tests Fixture - Install Execution Context
brief: #4049: the runner sets BC's NavSession.AppInstallationContext around this bundle's install triggers and clears it afterwards.
description: AlRunner#4049: the install trigger records Session.GetExecutionContext() and Session.GetCurrentModuleExecutionContext(); the tests read the recorded values and the same calls at test time, so a context that was never set and a context that was never cleared both fail.
